survey.sub_type_reason: The sheet combines a power one-line topology (batteries, chargers, GMDSS panel, emergency battery feeding breaker banks) on the left/center with a relay/terminal wiring network (multiple T/S E terminal strips, relay bank Re1-Re6, indicator lamp terminal columns, and numbered terminal taps to alarm/monitoring buses) on the right. Neither a pure repeated distribution schedule nor a single connected one-line topology dominates; it is a mixed emergency-supply/radio/nav-lights schematic per its own title.
survey.notes: Sheet is dense with many small terminal strip fragments labeled T/S E scattered across the top and right (numbers 1-13, 19-21, 22-37, 38-58) that likely belong to a small number of physical terminal strips split visually by routing; grouped here by proximity/number range rather than as fully separate strips. Diamond-enclosed numbers on wires (e.g. 95, 25, 10, 6) are wire-gauge callouts per sheet convention, not devices. Several relay symbols (Re1-Re6, Re aux.) have dotted linkage lines to remote contacts not fully traceable at this resolution - contact routing to right-side terminal columns (42-58) is approximate. Emergency Panel enclosure (dotted boundary) contains CB5-CB8, Primary/Emergency Power Ind. terminal column, and MUTE pushbutton - not fully separated into its own region above due to overlap with breaker bank. Text quality generally legible; some small fuse rating labels (F 0.1A) repeated near LOPO nav lights are legible but numerous.
